review.official:
Born in
Londinium
in
Victoria
, Hibiscus is the older twin sister of her fellow
Operator
,
Lava
. After contracting
Oripathy
, she came to
Rhodes Island
for treatment. While undergoing that treatment, she began to dream of helping others. Her passion for caring for others, as well as her hard work, have led Hibiscus to become a Rhodes Island Medic.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.4%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.2 u/L
Degree of infection is minor and physical symptoms are not yet present.

Though she possess basic Originium Arts, Hibiscus prefers not to utilize her Originium power. Instead she would rather use her medical skills to care for and treat the wounds of her allies. Given her talents in medicine, Hibiscus has become an outstanding Rhodes Island Medic Operator.

Born in Londinium, Hibiscus was popular among her neighbors as a child, and for good reason - she is considerate, hardworking, courteous, modest, and is good at taking care of people. Though it appears to outsiders that Lava does not like to deal with Hibiscus and that the two sisters don't share a strong relationship, Hibiscus knows the truth - that Lava just isn't very good at expressing those kinds of feelings.

After the two sisters were infected with Oripathy, Hibiscus took Lava and left their parents to come to Rhodes Island. The determined Hibiscus decided to work hard for Rhodes Island, for her sister, herself, her parents back home, and all the other infected.

Because of Lava's obstinance, Hibiscus has cultivated a tough attitude from the time they were little. 'This food is good for you. You need to eat it every day!' 'I threw all your snacks away because they're bad for you!' 'It's 10:30. You need to go to bed!' From a bystanders' perspective, Lava seems to have a rough time dealing with her older sister.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Did you call for me, Doctor? I feel so happy to be with you!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor! Dr. Kal'tsit said that you need to look after your health more. In two words, E-A-T L-E-S-S! So there!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You know, Doctor, if my sister starts getting all bossy with you, you have to tell me! She needs my treatment or else!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit teaches me a ton of practical stuff, although it's tough to actually learn! At least I've always had a knack for nutrition, so I think I'm doing well with that!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I feel better about everyone here, compared to when I just joined Rhodes Island! And they all eat my healthy food on schedule! But... why does everyone pull these weird faces when they finish?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Tadaaaaaah! A special healthy meal just for you, Doctor! Decaf coffee and a hamburger without meat, cheese, pickles, or lettuce! Oh, and a mixed salad made of 12 different vegetables!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, where does your family live? Are they doing well? I know there's things you can't tell them about because they're your family... but, still, I think you've got to reach out. You have to try, at least.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Isn't it lonely cooking all by yourself? Let me help you out! Oh, right, and let's get Lava in here too!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, did you fall asleep? Have a good rest then. You need to sleep plenty to stay healthy.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: This is intern Hibiscus. From now on, I'll be in charge of managing yours and every Operator's health at Rhodes Island. Thank you for your cooperation!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh, I see! So that's how you do it!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: It's my honor to be promoted! I'm looking forward to working under you for the health management of us all, Doctor!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I won't fail you! I'll protect everyone!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Acknowledged! I'll take good care of everyone! First, I need to get my special sustained-release medicine ready...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Please take good care of yourself while I'm gone!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ready to heal!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't be afraid!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: There we go.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's safe here!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Please come to your senses!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I can heal that wound in no time!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Even if everyone gets wounded, I can heal them all with my staff!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Looking after everyone's health is my greatest motivation.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor! Everyone! Are you alright?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No... First aid needed!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Anything I can help with?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, my~!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, do you want to have a taste of my new vitamin drink?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Here, Doctor, your new customized healthy daily schedule! Relax, given this full table of gourmet food we have here, I will make an exception today. I will allow you — one bite of fries! That'll be my most generous offer!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor! Would you mind tasting this?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Stop hiding the cakes, Doctor. They aren't escaping my eyes!... Look at all these cakes you have here! It takes three full teaspoons of sugar to whip the cream for just one of them, let alone the milk and butter that went in there. I know, I understand they are just tokens of appreciation from your fellow operators. But you could have just looked at them — Hey, don't steal a bite when I'm talking!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: They had a celebration today? I was so occupied that I hardly noticed… Doesn't matter, as long as there are wounded looking for treatment, my job's not finished. Not to mention the goal I set for myself to become a better medic. See you then, Doctor, for I still got works to tend to!
